title: Fluency: the line through two points

families.skill: find the gradient from two points
families.prompt: Find the gradient of the line through $A({x1}, {y1})$ and $B({x2}, {y2})$.

wrong.line: You divided the run by the rise: the gradient is the rise, ${rise}$, over the run, ${run}$.
Take both differences in the same order: from A to B the rise is ${rise}$ and the run is ${run}$.

solution: The rise is ${y2} - {y1:()} = {rise}$ and the run is ${x2} - {x1:()} = {run}$.

families.skill: find the equation of the line
families.prompt: Find the equation of the line through $A({x1}, {y1})$ and $B({x2}, {y2})$, in the form $y = mx + c$.

wrong.line: The intercept is the height at $x = 0$, not the height of A: put A into $y = {m:c}x + c$ to find $c$.
From ${y1} = {mx1} + c$, take ${mx1:()}$ from both sides: $c = {y1} - {mx1:()} = {c}$.

solution: A fits the line: ${y1} = {m} \times {x1:()} + c$, so ${y1} = {mx1} + c$ and $c = {c}$.
